en.headline: Grace Lau wins Hong Kong's first Asian Games medal with karate silver
en.dek: The world number one took silver in the women's individual kata final in Nagoya after a 0-5 defeat by Japan's Maho Ono, upgrading her previous two bronzes.
body: Hong Kong karate athlete Grace Lau Mo-sheung claimed silver in the women's individual kata at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Sunday, delivering the city's first medal of the Games.

Lau, the current world number one, reached the final for the first time after two straight 5-0 victories. She defeated Iran's Atefeh Sadeghi Dastak in the quarter-finals performing Chatanyara Kushanku and then beat Chinese Taipei's Chien Hui-hsuan in the semi-finals with Happoren.

In the final she faced long-time rival Maho Ono of Japan, the host favourite. Lau performed Aohan Dai while Ono chose Hyaku Hachi Te. The judges scored the bout 0-5 in favour of Ono, leaving Lau with silver.

The result upgrades Lau's Asian Games record from two bronzes at the previous editions. She had entered the competition seeking her first continental Games gold but remains among Asia's strongest kata performers.

zh.headline: 劉慕裳空手道個人形奪銀 香港亞運首面獎牌
zh.dek: 世界排名第一的劉慕裳在名古屋亞運會女子個人形決賽以0比5不敵日本選手小野真步，為香港帶來本屆亞運首面獎牌。
body: 香港空手道運動員劉慕裳周日在愛知-名古屋亞運會女子個人形項目奪得銀牌，為香港帶來本屆亞運首面獎牌。
現時世界排名第一的劉慕裳先後以5比0擊敗伊朗選手及中華台北選手，首次打入決賽。她在四分之一決賽表演Chatanyara Kushanku，半決賽則表演Happoren。
決賽對上宿敵、東道主日本選手小野真步。劉慕裳選擇Aohan Dai，小野真步則表演Hyaku Hachi Te，裁判最終以0比5判小野真步勝出。
此銀牌令劉慕裳的亞運成績由過往兩屆銅牌升級。她今次以爭金目標出戰，即使未能奪金，仍被視為亞洲最強個人形選手之一。
